top_choice_rationale: P001 (Mircea Cărtărescu alone) is the only proposal that awards a writer, and on the common criteria it holds up after round 2. The voice is recognisable and carried by long, patterned sentences. Formal ambition is sustained across very large structures, as publicly described for the Orbitor trilogy (Blinding) and Solenoid. Memory, the body and dream form one coherent imaginative and intellectual project, and it does not depend on topicality, nationality or political symbolism. The shared citation (prose as the load-bearing element, poetry as formative root, no regional or period label) claims no more than the translated evidence supports. The reservations remain real: Romanian rhythm and syntax cannot be judged through translation, whether the late novels extend or repeat the early project is unresolved, and coverage of the poetry and early prose is thin. None of these shows a failure of a stated criterion. They limit how fully the case can be tested, so they do not justify P000 over awarding. This judgment rests on public knowledge and the supplied descriptions, with no independent verification. The unanimity of the round-2 files is not treated as evidence of merit.
